meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 将 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux。它会自动补齐缺失的资源组、服务计划和 Web 应用，设置启动命令与构建环境变量，完成部署后输出一段提示信息并结束，不做部署后的健康检查。
howto.when: 当你说“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等，或要求部署 Python 到 App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: Claude 会检测框架并部署。

say.text: 用 azd 部署我的 FastAPI 项目到 App Service
say.note: 存在 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署路径。

say.text: 部署 Django 代码到 App Service Linux
say.note: 会自动创建资源并设置启动命令。

howto.what_en: Deploy Python code to Azure App Service Linux. It creates missing resource group, plan, and web app, sets startup command and build environment variable, prints a post-deploy message, and ends without post-deploy health checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', or when you ask to deploy Python to Azure App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Claude will detect the framework and deploy.

say_en.text: Deploy my FastAPI project to App Service using azd
say_en.note: Uses azd path if azure.yaml exists.

say_en.text: Deploy Django code to App Service Linux
say_en.note: Creates resources and sets startup command.
